nodes.text: Workup and Treatment of Low-Volume M1 (Metachronous or Synchronous) or Synchronous Oligometastatich CSPC (PROS-14)

• Perform physical exam • Perform imaging for stagingg • Perform and/or collect PSA and calculate PSADT • Estimate life expectancy (Principles of Life Expectancy Estimation [PROS-A]) • Perform germline and somatic genetic testinge (if not previously done) • Obtain family historye • Assess quality-of-life measuresf
• Physical examination + PSA every 3–6 mo • Imaging for symptomsg • Consider periodic imaging to monitor treatment response
